mentions.name: Skyrim Switch Mod Manager
mentions.description: A mod manager for the Nintendo Switch version of Skyrim that converts, renames, and packs mods in bulk. It is built for personal use to ease the tedium of frequently changing the mod list, with plans to add a proper GUI and release it publicly later.
mentions.problem: Converting, renaming, and packing mods in bulk is very tedious, especially when frequently changing the mod list.
mentions.audience: Mainly the author for personal use, with a planned public release once it is more user-friendly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Skyrim mod manager for the Nintendo Switch version of the game.

It’s mainly for personal use because converting, renaming, and packing mods in bulk can be very tedious. Especially if you're always changing your mod list (which is a given).
